title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered insights on meeting quality in the Teams admin center
notes: claim 55: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing turns unpublished controls into definite claims that no budget control applies and that anomaly detection cannot be tuned. The rollout, access paths and licensing uncertainty are otherwise supported, but Microsoft's notice does not establish those restrictions or explicitly describe the feature as read-only.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice says no configuration is required.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page describing these specific insights was found at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "intelligent insights" "meeting quality"; "Teams" "intelligent insights" "meeting quality" licensing billing. Opened Monitor and troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls and Best practice configurations dashboard; neither describes this new insights experience.

claims.claim: The existing documented troubleshooting experience provides per-user and per-meeting investigation.
claims.quote: diagnose and resolve meeting and call quality issues for individual users and meetings across your organization.

claims.claim: The existing troubleshooting experience already offers suggested root cause analysis per meeting.
claims.quote: **Meeting view** - Shows the details of a specific meeting, including participant summaries, issue trends, and suggested root cause analysis.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The notice says the feature does not alter how customer data is stored or processed.
claims.quote: it does not alter how customer data is stored or processed.

claims.claim: The existing troubleshooting documentation says identifiable information for federated and external participants is obfuscated.
claims.quote: For federated and external participants, end-user identifiable information (EUII) is obfuscated to protect privacy in accordance with Microsoft data handling policies.
claims.fix: Add the qualification 'except for peer-to-peer calls, where relevant identifiable information is not obfuscated'. The cited page states that exception immediately afterwards. This does not change the new insights' stated scope because MC1523077 excludes peer-to-peer telemetry.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not establish whether the same participant-information obfuscation applies to the new insights.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams intelligent insights meeting quality affected users administrative units obfuscated telemetry retention. Opened Monitor and troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls; its obfuscation statement concerns the meeting participant view, not the new insights.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Who sees it; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The notice lists Global Administrators, Teams Administrators, Teams Communications Administrators, Teams Communications Support Engineers and Teams Communications Support Specialists as the audience.
claims.quote: The experience is available to Global Administrators, Teams Administrators, Teams Communications Administrators, Teams Communications Support Engineers, and Teams Communications Support Specialists.

claims.quote: Troubleshoot communications issues within Teams by using **basic** tools. | Access user profile page for troubleshooting calls in Call Analytics. Can only view user information for the specific user being searched for.

claims.claim: The feature descriptions do not describe a new identity, permission or consent requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "intelligent insights" disable PowerShell Graph policy administrative units privacy; "Teams" "intelligent insights" "meeting quality". Read full MC1523077 and the roadmap; they name existing admin roles but no new identity, permission or consent.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe the feature changing settings itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "intelligent insights" "meeting quality". Read full MC1523077; it describes administrators taking recommended actions, not automatic setting changes. Opened Monitor and troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls; no description of these insights automating changes.

claims.claim: MC1523077 says the insights are read-only analysis.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "intelligent insights" "meeting quality". Read MC1523077 in full and opened meeting-troubleshooting documentation. The notice describes analysis and recommended actions but does not explicitly establish a read-only guarantee.
claims.fix: Replace 'says the insights are read-only analysis of existing meeting-quality data' with 'says the insights analyse historical meeting-quality data and surface recommendations'. Retain the separately supported statement about unchanged customer-data storage and processing.
